CHANGE_VIEW.note: Square <-> race-track view toggle (bottom-right of cloth). Live verified.

LAYOUT_SWITCH.note: Top-right game/layout selector (cards+dice icon, directly above the lock). Godot GameSelector: disabledOnBetsClosed / disabledOnBetsPresent / disableInAdditionalView, so click during open betting with an empty board. NOT the bottom-right CHANGE_VIEW race toggle.

AYUDA.note: Help chrome: HELP_BACK/NEXT/EXIT mapped (shared with layout2).

CREDIT_DISPLAY.note: Credit readout doubles as the credits<->currency control. Godot UpperBarSpanish/CreditSwapButton is a 340x90 TouchScreenButton wired to OnCreditReleased; the legacy singlewheel layout gives the same readout action TemporaryShowMoney. It is momentary, not a latching toggle: lab .90 showed '900 COP' while held (9 credits at 100 COP denom) and reverted to '9' on release, so a single click is invisible to a 44 s remote capture.

OPACITY_SLIDER.note: OPACIDAD slider: eye-off icon, gradient track, handle ring, eye-on icon. Godot components/upperBar/OpacitySlider.tscn is a single TouchScreenButton (RectangleShape2D extents 116x21) running DragScrollButton.cs, whose SelectedXAmount signal feeds OpacitySlider._on_value_set and UpperBar._on_OpacitySlider_ValueChanged. Because the value is taken from the picked X, a TAP on the track sets it outright - live on .90 taps at x=1120 and x=1150 parked the ring at 1119 / 1149. Over-dragging clamps at x=1103 (value 0.0) and x=1233 (value 1.0); see 'slider' for the mapping. Moving it produced no visible change to the bars or the cloth in the normal square view, so treat it as cosmetic state. Drive it with automation.roulette_slider.set_slider / script_for_slider_set.

STATISTICS.note: Opens the full-screen statistics / history panel (last numbers, hot-cold, pie charts). Live verified on .90: 958k px change. Close with STATS_EXIT (SALIR) - pressing this tab again does NOT close it.

HISTORY_PREV.note: Left chevron at the older end of the last-numbers strip. Glyph measured at 112-124 x 167-197, padded here to a clickable box. It sits OUTSIDE HISTORY_STRIP (which starts at x=146), so it is a separate control. A single tap did not page the strip on .90: the only changes between captures were newly arriving spin results, with the newest number still anchored left.

HISTORY_NEXT.note: Right chevron at the newer end of the last-numbers strip. Glyph measured at 1792-1804 x 167-196, padded here to a clickable box. Also outside HISTORY_STRIP (which ends at x=1768). Same result as HISTORY_PREV: a tap produced no paging. Both are most likely drag affordances, or only become active once the strip has been dragged away from its home position - RouletteGui.pck wires scrolling to ButtonDragged, not to arrow buttons.

STATS_TAB.note: Active ESTADISTICAS tab inside the stats panel. Not a close button.

STATS_EXIT.note: SALIR (X) - the only way out of the statistics panel. Live verified on .90: board restored to within 1321 px of the pre-open capture. On the game screen this box overlaps chip_10, so never click it outside the panel.

HISTORY_STRIP.note: Last-numbers bar. Exact rect from RouletteGui.pck LastNumbersBar: TouchScreenButtonHistory at (957,191) with RectangleShape2D extents (811,50) and shape_centered=false, verified against the capture - the box lands on the first and last tile edges. Signals: ButtonDragged -> move (drag to scroll), ButtonHeld -> OpenStatistics, passby_press=true. Avoid clicking it in automation: a slow click can register as a hold and open the statistics modal. Scrolling it needs the InputAgent drag_window step (added 2026-07-24).
